ambiguities.quote: if the attack roll had Advantage
ambiguities.reading_a: The bonus die applies only if the roll was actually made with Advantage, i.e. after Advantage and Disadvantage cancel the roll no longer 'had Advantage' and there's no extra 1d4.
ambiguities.reading_b: The bonus die applies whenever any source granted Advantage, even if Disadvantage cancelled it.
ambiguities.proposed_ruling: Reading A: the extra 1d4 applies only when the attack roll is resolved with Advantage (two d20s, take the higher). Cancelled Advantage gives no bonus.

ambiguities.quote: Gear Leather Armor, Scimitar, Shield, Shortbow
ambiguities.reading_a: The stat block's actions can be used as written. The goblin can make Shortbow attacks without stowing its Shield, and AC 15 stays fixed.
ambiguities.reading_b: Hand use is tracked from the Gear line. Firing the two-handed Shortbow means doffing the Shield, which lowers AC.
ambiguities.proposed_ruling: Reading A: the engine doesn't track hand use for stat-block actions, and AC is the listed 15. Gear only matters for loot.

traps.note: In 2014 the goblin was a Small humanoid (goblinoid), Neutral Evil. In 2024 it's Fey, so spells and effects that key on creature type treat it differently: it isn't a valid Humanoid target, and it counts as Fey for effects that name that type.

traps.quote: plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
traps.note: The extra 1d4 on Advantage is new in 2024. The 2014 scimitar and shortbow dealt only 1d6 + 2.
The Initiative score in parentheses (10 + Dex modifier) is new in 2024. The 2014 stat block had no Initiative entry.

traps.quote: Gear Leather Armor, Scimitar, Shield, Shortbow
traps.note: 2014 listed the armour in the AC line ('leather armor, shield'). In 2024 the AC line is a bare number and equipment is a separate Gear line, so the AC isn't recalculated from the gear.

summary:
The Goblin Warrior stat block, split into 24 clauses. The checkable figures all agree with the glossary rules:
- Initiative score 12 is 10 + Dex +2.
- Passive Perception 9 is 10 + Wis −1.
- The Save column equals each modifier, so the goblin has no save proficiencies.

The rules needing an engine are:
- the extra 1d4 on attack rolls that had Advantage;
- the Nimble Escape bonus action (Disengage or Hide, with Hide's usual DC 15 Stealth and cover/obscurement requirements).

Ambiguities: whether Advantage cancelled by Disadvantage still triggers the bonus die, and whether the Gear line affects how the goblin attacks or its AC.

Traps from 2014: the creature type is now Fey, HP is 10 rather than 7, the Advantage bonus damage and Initiative score are new, and gear has its own line separate from AC.
